title: One-for-More: Continual Diffusion Model for Anomaly Detection
notes: Closest top-tier evidence that continual anomaly detection is an explicit task; industrial/medical image setting rather than user-personalized video.

title: Toward Long-Tailed Online Anomaly Detection through Class-Agnostic Concepts
notes: Online AD under changing class distribution; no human feedback or subject personalization.

title: Learning from One Continuous Video Stream
notes: Important protocol and online-stream learning reference; not anomaly detection.

title: Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection
notes: Relevant to open-world anomalies but not continual personalization.

title: Anomize: Better Open Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection
notes: Recent top-tier OVVAD; useful boundary marker showing open-world recognition is different from our evolving-normality problem.

title: Generative Cooperative Learning for Unsupervised Video Anomaly Detection
notes: Strong video anomaly baseline family; explicitly discusses OCC setting.

title: Else-Net: Elastic Semantic Network for Continual Action Recognition From Skeleton Data
notes: Strong evidence that continual learning on skeleton streams is established, but it is class/action recognition rather than anomaly personalization.

title: Data-Free Class-Incremental Hand Gesture Recognition
notes: Privacy/data-retention-relevant skeleton CL; not one-class anomaly detection.

title: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos
notes: Foundational top-tier VCIL reference; useful for temporal forgetting mechanisms, not target formulation.

title: vCLIMB: A Novel Video Class Incremental Learning Benchmark
notes: Benchmark/protocol reference for video continual learning; highlights temporal memory choices.

title: Space-time Prompting for Video Class-incremental Learning
notes: Efficient parameter adaptation in VCIL; useful later for resource-aware extension.

title: OneFlow: One-Class Flow for Anomaly Detection Based on a Minimal Volume Region
notes: Strong modern one-class method; not continual or personalized.

title: Timeseries Anomaly Detection using Temporal Hierarchical One-Class Network
notes: Top-tier temporal OCC reference; useful for normal-only temporal representation.

title: Deep One-Class Classification
notes: Seminal Deep SVDD reference retained despite pre-2020 cutoff because it is foundational.
